en: The image shows a rural European landscape featuring a small church with a Baroque-style steeple set on a raised stone foundation. The church is surrounded by a stone wall and a few trees. Next to the church, there are a couple of modest houses and outbuildings with pitched roofs, fenced gardens, and open cultivated fields. The image is in black and white, and no visible text or signage can be seen anywhere on the postcard.
